SELECT 'mcq',m.id,NULL,m.question,'Past-exam MCQ | source page '||m.source_page::text||' | question '||m.source_question_number FROM public.gk_mcqs m WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 694 AND 698 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.search_documents d WHERE d.entity_type='mcq' AND d.entity_id=m.id);
COMMIT;
